title.purpose: Runner name in the last-read sheet.

label.purpose: Uppercase labels, headers, buttons, nav, tags.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Character flip (520ms, 55ms stagger) and row highlight fade (2.4s).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled square button; the manual-entry action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:8px 20px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--sheet); border:2px solid var(--ink); font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:0.025em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 85%, transparent); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:disabled { background:var(--sheet); color:var(--ink-soft); border-style:dashed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search bib, name or tag">
components.css: .ds-input { height:44px; width:100%; padding:4px 12px; background:var(--sheet); color:var(--ink); border:2px solid var(--ink); font-size:16px; font-weight:500; outline:none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring); }

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; height:48px; width:100%; padding:0 12px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--sheet); border:2px solid var(--ink); font-size:18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.025em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Station Chip
components.description: Kind-colored word cell plus station name; color is never the only signal.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:stretch; border:2px solid var(--ink); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1; } .ds-chip-k { padding:4px 8px; letter-spacing:0.05em; background:var(--finish); color:#fff; } .ds-chip-n { padding:4px 8px; background:var(--sheet); white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Notched Sheet
components.description: Panel with 16px clipped corners and an ink border that follows the cut.
components.css: .ds-notch { position:relative; background:var(--ink); clip-path:polygon(16px 0,calc(100% - 16px) 0,100% 16px,100% calc(100% - 16px),calc(100% - 16px) 100%,16px 100%,0 calc(100% - 16px),0 16px); } .ds-notch-in { position:relative; margin:2px; padding:16px; background:var(--sheet); clip-path:polygon(15px 0,calc(100% - 15px) 0,100% 15px,100% calc(100% - 15px),calc(100% - 15px) 100%,15px 100%,0 calc(100% - 15px),0 15px); } .ds-notch-in h2 { margin:0; font-family:'Big Shoulders Display',Impact,sans-serif; font-weight:900; font-size:30px; line-height:.85; }

components.name: Last-Read Band
components.description: Kind-colored header band with pin holes over the monumental bib numeral.
components.css: .ds-band { position:relative; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:8px 56px; background:var(--start); color:#fff; font-size:24px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-band::before,.ds-band::after { content:''; position:absolute; top:50%; width:16px; height:16px; margin-top:-8px; border:2px solid var(--ink); border-radius:50%; background:var(--paper); } .ds-band::before { left:16px; } .ds-band::after { right:16px; }

narrative.overview: The whole app is a race bib read at arm's length: cool blue-white synthetic paper, black print ink, monumental condensed numerals, tear-off perforations and clipped corners. Hierarchy comes from scale contrast and 2px ink rules, never from shadow, tint, or rounding. Color is rationed to meaning: three station inks and a focus blue.
keyCharacteristics: Cool Tyvek paper ground, black ink.
Heavy condensed bib numerals for identity data; semi-condensed grotesk for everything else.
2px ink borders, square corners, zero shadows.
Perforation dots and 16px notched corners as the signature silhouette.
Station kind is always color plus word.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Word Rule
rules.body: A station kind is never color alone: the band or chip carries START, CHECKPOINT, or FINISH as text.

rules.name: The Station Ink Rule
rules.body: Green, orange, and vermilion mean station kind and status. They are never decoration.

rules.name: The Bib Numeral Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders is for numbers and short panel titles; running text, forms, and buttons stay in Barlow.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tabular numerals are on for the whole app.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 2px ink border or a paper-to-sheet step; shadows are out of system.

dos: Do keep every border 2px Print Ink and every corner square; use the 16px notch for major sheets.
Do pair every station color with its kind word.
Do set identity numbers in Big Shoulders 900 and everything else in Barlow Semi Condensed.
Do show state by fill inversion, dashed borders, and strikethrough.
Do reserve the flip and row flash for genuinely new reads.
donts: Don't add shadows, rounded corners, or gradient fills.
Don't use green, orange, or vermilion as decoration.
Don't introduce a warm cream ground.
Don't set body or form text in the display face.
